info.title: Student ID, please: service operations through the Gateway
info.description: Generated from contracts/http/service-operations.json. Do not edit by hand.

get.summary: The game's answer key. Service-only: it must never be reachable on a public /api/v1 route or by a player token.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

404.description: 404 APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND: unknown applicant, or not in that session

post.summary: Posts one announcement in #general-mod-chat and fans it out across replicas. Never scores and never republishes.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

409.description: 409 SESSION_CHAT_NOT_INITIALIZED: ShiftStarted not processed yet; not acknowledged, resend later

post.summary: Creates the four default channels and one announcement in #general-mod-chat; 200 only after both are stored in Redis.
post.x-idempotency: eventId with a persisted content digest: identical repeat 200 DUPLICATE, different content 409 EVENT_CONFLICT; an interrupted delivery is re-processed with deterministic effects

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

400.description: 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST: not an envelope, or unknown top-level field

403.description: 403 PRODUCER_MISMATCH: envelope.producer is not the authenticated caller

409.description: 409 EVENT_CONFLICT: eventId reused with different content

get.summary: The applicant's documents, at most 32. Receiver implementation accepted this catalog path. Validation fails closed without trusted provenance or authoritative Record facts.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

get.summary: Credential's authoritative verdict on one document. Moderation fans these out in parallel inside its deadline. Receiver implementation accepted this catalog path. Validation fails closed without trusted provenance or authoritative Record facts.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

get.summary: Moderation's own recorded decisions about an applicant for a prior-ban check. Read-only; never evaluates or calls another service, so it cannot recurse into rules.evaluate. Returns no expected action, violations or correctness.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

post.summary: Authoritative violations for the session's ruleset. Rules obtains the facts it needs with its own service identity (record facts below, moderation.applicantDecisionFacts), never by impersonating a player. Receiver implementation accepted this catalog path and enforces a 500 ms target budget. Session context and peer fact bindings remain pending.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

post.summary: Advances the queue and counts the decision. It never applies a score (session.applyScoreChange already did) and is never republished.
post.x-idempotency: eventId: identical repeat is 200 DUPLICATE with no effect; different content is 409 EVENT_CONFLICT

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

post.summary: 200 with member=false and empty role/arrays for unknown sessions, non-members, unassigned players and completed sessions. Membership comes only from persisted Session assignments.

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

503.description: 503: database failure; never a permission denial

post.summary: The only score/penalty mutation. reason DECISION, APPEAL_REFUND or DECISION_VOID; a decision causes at most one change of each reason. Session must not score DecisionRecorded again.
post.x-idempotency: scoreChangeId: the same id with identical content applies at most once and returns applied=false with the current score; the same id with different content is 409 SCORE_CHANGE_CONFLICT

parameters.name: X-Service-Name
parameters.description: set by the Gateway to the authenticated caller

422.description: 422 INVALID_SCORE_CHANGE: schema or business validation failed (final)
